The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: # Application card: GitHub Copilot Chat Learn how to use GitHub Copilot Chat responsibly by understanding its purposes, capabilities, and limitations. ## What is an Application Card?
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: GitHub’s application and platform cards are intended to help you understand how our AI technology works, the choices application owners can make that influence application performance and behavior, and the importance of considering the whole application, including the technology, the people, and the environment.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: Application cards are created for AI applications and platform cards are created for AI platform services.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: These resources can support the development or deployment of your own applications and can be shared with users or stakeholders impacted by them.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: As part of its commitment to responsible AI, GitHub adheres to Microsoft's [six core principles](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/ai/principles-and-approach/?msockid=3da790040c776d6f2b5485e40de56c06#ai-principles): fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: These principles are embedded in the [Responsible AI Standard](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/microsoft/final/en-us/microsoft-brand/documents/Microsoft-Responsible-AI-Standard-General-Requirements.pdf?culture=en-us\&country=us), which guides teams in designing, building, and testing AI applications.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: Application and Platform Cards play a key role in operationalizing these principles by offering transparency around capabilities, intended uses, and limitations.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: For further insight, readers are encouraged to explore Microsoft’s [Responsible AI Transparency Report](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/microsoft/msc/documents/presentations/CSR/Responsible-AI-Transparency-Report-2025-vertical.pdf) and [GitHub Terms](/en/site-policy/github-terms). ## 1.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: Overview GitHub Copilot Chat is a chat interface that lets you interact with GitHub Copilot to ask and receive answers to coding-related questions.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: GitHub Copilot Chat is available on GitHub.com, in supported IDEs (VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, and Eclipse), on GitHub Mobile, and in Windows Terminal.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: On GitHub.com and in GitHub Desktop, Copilot can also generate pull request summaries and commit messages—AI-powered overviews of changes made in a pull request or commit.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: GitHub Copilot Chat can answer a wide range of coding-related questions on topics including syntax, programming concepts, test cases, debugging, and more.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: GitHub Copilot Chat is not designed to answer non-coding questions or provide general information on topics outside of coding.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: The primary supported language for GitHub Copilot Chat is English. ## 2.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: Key terms The following list provides a glossary of key terms related to GitHub Copilot Chat: * **Content filtering**: A safety system that scans prompts and responses to detect and block harmful content before it is shown to the user. * **Hallucination**: A phenomenon where a language model generates output that sounds plausible but is factually incorrect, unsupported by the provided context, or entirely fabricated.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: Hallucinations are a known risk of large language models and are reason that human review of AI-generated output is important. * **Large language model (LLM)**: A type of neural network trained on a large body of text data that can generate, analyze, and transform natural language and code.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: GitHub Copilot Chat uses one or more LLMs to process prompts and produce responses. * **Prompt**: The input that is provided to GitHub Copilot Chat.
The record for Cashcoin123/Cashcoin123 states in its own description: The system combines the prompt with additional context (for example, open files or repository data) before sending it to the language model. * **Public code matching**: A feature that checks whether Copilot's suggestions match publicly available code.
